lines.zh: 奥斯卡鱼摆尾游过水草
lines.en: The oscar swims past the weeds with a flick of its tail.
It banks into a small turn.

lines.zh: 鳞片在浑水里闪了一下
lines.en: Its scales flash in the murk.
It swims just above the pebbles.
It accelerates and the water sways.
It skirts a rising string of bubbles.
Its fins spread to hold position.
It pauses beside a sunken post.

lines.zh: 它把头朝下，像在找什么
lines.en: It points its head down as if searching.
One tailbeat carries it far.

lines.zh: 它游得很有劲，不慌不忙
lines.en: It swims strongly, without hurry.

lines.zh: 它从桥墩的阴影里穿出
lines.en: It comes out of a pier's shadow.

lines.zh: 奥斯卡鱼悬在水草之间
lines.en: The oscar hangs among the weeds.
Its fins flutter gently.
Its gill covers open and close.
Its mouth opens and takes in water.
Its colour deepens in the light.
It nudges a pebble loose.
It turns, showing its ventral fins.
It holds place, tail barely moving.
One eye shifts.

lines.zh: 水面上的光斑在它背上滑
lines.en: Light slides across its back.

lines.zh: 它慢慢地往上浮了一点
lines.en: It floats up a little.
Then sinks back down.

lines.zh: 它的鳞纹一条条很清楚
lines.en: The lines on its flanks are clear.

lines.zh: 它像是这块水域的常住户
lines.en: It looks like a long-time resident.

lines.zh: 奥斯卡鱼转过来对着你
lines.en: The oscar turns to face you.
It hangs there, motionless.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛圆圆的，很直接
lines.en: Its round eye is very direct.
I watch you through the water.

lines.zh: 它似乎在打量你的手指
lines.en: It seems to study your fingers.
It comes a little closer.
Its mouth opens and closes without biting.
Its fins flare toward you.
It retreats behind the weeds.
A moment later it comes back out.
It is neither afraid nor friendly.

lines.zh: 它把你当成了水里的东西
lines.en: It takes you for part of the water.

lines.zh: 它开始绕圈，一圈比一圈近
lines.en: It circles, closer each lap.

lines.zh: 它用吻部碰了碰你的手指
lines.en: Its snout taps your finger.
Then it swims off to look at something else.
Its attention span is comically short.
It turns sharply; ripples spread.

lines.zh: 它似乎更在意你的倒影
lines.en: It seems more interested in your reflection.
The oscar bolts away.
Its fins beat wildly for a moment.
Its colour dulls.
It ducks into a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 一小片鳞掉了，露出白肉
lines.en: A scale comes off, showing pale flesh.
It swims at a tilt.
It rushes back, angrier.
It thrashes a weed in its mouth.
Its gills work faster.
It circles rather than charging in.

lines.zh: 奥斯卡鱼一口咬走食物
lines.en: The oscar snaps up the food.

lines.zh: 它把食物含在嘴里又吐出
lines.en: It holds the food, then spits it out.
It tastes it, then truly swallows.
It rises for a second mouthful.
It shoulders smaller fish aside.
It shoves the food into a crevice.
Its belly rounds out with eating.
It comes back for more.
It is fierce when competing for food.

lines.zh: 它吃完在水里转了个圈
lines.en: Fed, it turns a circle in the water.

lines.zh: 奥斯卡鱼撞上你的手，滑开
lines.en: The oscar bumps your hand and slides off.
A sideways flick rights it.
Its fin brushes your wrist.
The push turns it around.
It swims back as if unwilling to yield.
It slips between your fingers.
Its scales feel faintly rough.

lines.zh: 它退开水花，绕到另一边
lines.en: It backs off and goes round.
It stops half an arm away.
A tail flick, and it keeps its distance.

lines.zh: 两条奥斯卡鱼并排游动
lines.en: Two oscars swim side by side.
Their turns match exactly.

lines.zh: 一条跟上另一条的尾流
lines.en: One rides the other's wake.

lines.zh: 它们绕着同一块石头打转
lines.en: They circle the same stone.
Their fins flare together.

lines.zh: 它们贴近了，又各自散开
lines.en: They draw close, then part.

lines.zh: 两条影子在水底合成一条
lines.en: Two shadows merge on the bottom.
The weeds sway where they pass.
They hang quietly abreast.

lines.zh: 这一小片水域只属于它们
lines.en: This little patch of water is theirs.
The oscar swallows it whole.

lines.zh: 它咬住又吐出来试味道
lines.en: It bites, spits, and tastes.
It pushes the item with its snout.

lines.zh: 它从水底叼起一块碎肉
lines.en: It takes a scrap of meat off the bottom.
It pins the food under a stone.
It snatches and swims off.
What it dislikes, it flings aside.
Eating too fast, it gags.
It returns for the fallen crumbs.
Sated, it sinks slowly.
The oscar turns on you suddenly.
All its fins spread.

lines.zh: 它把身体侧过来，显得更大
lines.en: It turns broadside to look bigger.
It closes on your fingers.
Its mouth opens wide.
It butts the back of your hand.
It backs off and charges again.
It has taken you for an intruder.
Its thrashing throws water everywhere.
It circles your hand.
Its colour darkens a shade.
It decides to try a bite.
It comes up from below.

lines.zh: 它的动作忽然变得很快
lines.en: Its movements suddenly speed up.
It is already charging.
The water churns white around it.

lines.zh: 奥斯卡鱼在你手边打转
lines.en: The oscar circles by your hand.
It keeps to your flank.

lines.zh: 它时不时撞一下你的手指
lines.en: It butts your fingers from time to time.
It is testing which part is softest.
It withdraws and comes around again.
It worries at a weed as if sharpening.
Its fins stay spread.
It goes still for an instant.
Then it lunges again.
Its movements grow more frantic.
It clamps on your cuff.

lines.zh: 它甩头，想把布料扯下来
lines.en: It thrashes, trying to tear the cloth.
The water shoves it back half a block.
And straight back it comes.
There is no fear in its eye.
It has simply decided to bite.

lines.zh: 你的手在水里很不灵活
lines.en: Your hand is clumsy in the water.
It uses that against you.

lines.zh: 奥斯卡鱼咬住你的手指
lines.en: The oscar bites your finger.
It shakes its head and tears.
It rams your hand, hard.
It grips your cuff and hauls.
It bites your wrist from the side.
Fine teeth, but a solid bite.
It strikes, withdraws, circles back.
Water splashes into your face.
The whole fish slams into you.
It bites air and its teeth click.
The second bite lands truer.

lines.zh: 它把身体压在你手背上
lines.en: It presses its body down on your hand.
Its fins slap the water loudly.
It lets go, backs off, and re-aims.
It takes a lap before returning.

lines.zh: 它还是不肯放弃你的手
lines.en: It still will not give up on your hand.

lines.zh: 水面下有个影子晃了一下
lines.en: A shape shifts under the surface.

lines.zh: 奥斯卡鱼从水草后游出来
lines.en: The oscar swims out from behind the weeds.
Its scales shine in the murk.
It takes a lap before coming near.
Bubbles rise from its mouth.
It dips its head and lifts it again.
It pushes a floating leaf aside.
It hangs there, watching you.
Its fins open slowly.
It begins patrolling around you.

lines.zh: 水底的泥被它带起一点
lines.en: It lifts a little silt off the bottom.

lines.zh: 又一个影子从深处上来
lines.en: Another shape rises from the deep.
Two fish approach side by side.
Their movements are identical.

lines.zh: 水草被它们撞得摇个不停
lines.en: The weeds rock where they pass.
They stop, square to you.
And then the circling starts.
You are in the middle of it.
The water heats and it darts wildly.

lines.zh: 离了水，它拍着尾巴乱弹
lines.en: Out of water it slaps and flops.

lines.zh: 空气里它张着嘴，鳃乱动
lines.en: In air its mouth works and gills flutter.

lines.zh: 冲击把它掀得翻了白肚
lines.en: The blast flips it belly-up.

lines.zh: 箭扎进它的身侧，它一甩
lines.en: An arrow strikes its flank; it thrashes.

lines.zh: 怪力钻进来，它一阵痉动
lines.en: Odd force enters and it convulses.
Starved thin, it swims unsteadily.

lines.zh: 电顺着水包住它，它僵住
lines.en: Current wraps through the water; it locks up.

lines.zh: 水流被抽走，它翻着往下掉
lines.en: The water drains away and it tumbles down.
